integrity.proof_type: analytic argument with exact finite-graph checks for small orders
integrity.residual_risk: Equivalent unindexed graph-geometry statements could exist.

scientific_limitations: Real scalars and finite metrics only; equality proved for unit-edge connected simple graphs containing an actual triangle. For general finite metrics with a minimum-distance equilateral triple only the <=1/2 upper bound is proved. Triangle-free graphs, weighted graphs, complex scalars, and infinite cases not classified.
title: Minimum-distance triangles force numerical index one half for finite graph free spaces
